resources.string: Unplug your charger to preserve battery health.
Connect charger to prevent device shutdown.
Alerts when battery drops below %s. Tap here to modify.
Tap here to enter your phone\'s official design capacity in mAh (usually found in device specifications).
Your battery is currently holding %s of its original design capacity

Shows the battery\'s capacity or energy storage level in milliampere-hours (mAh). It is calculated from the system\'s charge counter and battery level parameters, reflecting the absolute charge capacity rather than a percentage.

Estimates the remaining time until the battery reaches 100% capacity while plugged in. It is calculated dynamically by tracking positive percentage increments over elapsed time, using a rolling average formula (elapsedMs / increase) multiplied by the remaining percentage points to full.

Measures the electrical flow moving in or out of the battery in milliamperes (mA). Positive values indicate energy flowing in while charging, while negative values represent power consumption. This is queried directly from Android\'s system BatteryManager API.
Need help or have feedback? Contact the developer

Estimates how long the battery will last before the device powers down completely. It is computed by tracking continuous percentage drops over elapsed time, smoothing the results with a rolling weight factor, and multiplying the current percentage by the consumption rate.
Press back again to exit Battery Plus…

Reflects the overall physical condition and degradation state of the battery cell (e.g., Good, Overheated, Dead). It is read directly from system health status flags provided by the Android runtime environment.
Choose which battery statistics and metrics to display in your live notification.
Displays real-time battery stats in your notification bar and alerts you when your battery is low or fully charged.
Notification permission was denied. Tap the button again to try, or enable notifications manually in App Info > Notifications.
Reflects the total energy consumption or delivery rate in watts (W) in real time. It is calculated by multiplying the active current (converted to amperes) by the current system voltage.
Discover how Battery Plus works — open-source and transparent
Automatically resume battery monitoring and notifications when your device turns on. Requires live notification enabled.
Identifies the internal chemical composition of your battery cell, such as Li-ion (Lithium-ion) or Li-poly. This is retrieved as a string straight from the system\'s hardware identification extras.

Monitors the internal thermal state of the battery pack to help protect against overheating and preserve hardware lifespan. This value is pulled directly from the device\'s thermal sensors via system battery broadcast intents.

Indicates the electric potential difference powering your device\'s hardware, measured in volts (V). It naturally fluctuates up or down depending on the battery level and system load, and is read straight from system battery broadcasts.
